en.t: Lady Murasaki also read this reply.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“我曾劝她入宫。

en.t: Genji said to her, “I once urged her to enter the palace.

units.source_text: 但秋好皇后在名义上也是我的女儿，玉鬘倘使得了恩宠，对秋好有所不便。

en.t: But Empress Akikonomu is also nominally my daughter, and if Tamakazura were to win the Emperor’s favor, it would create difficulties for Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 再则，倘向内大臣说穿了，作为他的女儿入宫，则弘徽殿女御也在宫中，姐妹争宠，亦非所宜。

en.t: Moreover, if I told the Minister of the Interior the truth and sent her to court as his daughter, the Kokiden Consort is already there, and it would hardly be proper for sisters to compete for favor.
That is why I cannot make up my mind.

units.source_text: 一个青年女子入宫，如果承宠无所顾忌，则窥见天颜之后，恐怕不会无动于衷吧。”

en.t: If a young woman enters the palace and receives favor without restraint, then after glimpsing His Majesty’s face, she could hardly remain unmoved, could she?”
Lady Murasaki answered, “Do not talk nonsense!

units.source_text: 即使看见皇上相貌长得漂亮，一个女子自己发心入宫，也未免太冒失了。”

en.t: Even if she saw that the Emperor was handsome, it would still be far too rash for a woman to decide on her own to enter the palace.”

units.source_text: 源氏也笑着说：“哪里的话！

en.t: Genji also laughed and said, “What are you saying!

units.source_text: 要是你，恐怕早就动心了呢！”

en.t: If it were you, I suspect your heart would have been stirred long ago!”
